criteria.passage: I’d start by getting both sides’ updates and lining them up with the repair plan, so I know what’s done and what’s still open. I’d want to hear the contractor’s view on the parts shortage and whether there’s any workaround, and I’d also check whether the site manager has seen any sign that the schedule is slipping.

criteria.rationale: The candidate explicitly recognizes a worsening delay as a trigger for action, indicating awareness that deviation from the expected plan requires intervention.

criteria.passage: I’d pass that along to the right lead and make sure the next shift has the latest status. I’d keep monitoring it from there until I had a better sense of where things stood.
